firstAid.title: Heat Exhaustion
firstAid.body: Move the person to a shaded or cool area. Give water in small sips. Loosen tight clothing. Seek medical help if symptoms persist (dizziness, nausea, rapid pulse).

firstAid.title: Minor Cuts & Wounds
firstAid.body: Wash hands before treating. Clean the wound with clean water. Apply pressure with a clean cloth to stop bleeding. Cover with a bandage. Visit the medical team if bleeding does not stop.

firstAid.title: Fainting
firstAid.body: Lay the person flat and elevate legs slightly. Ensure adequate airflow. Do not give food or drink until fully conscious. Alert the Medical & DRRM Team immediately.
